title: [GMCP 203.040.05] Interoperability and quality: OpenTelemetry, metrics, logs, traces, and diagnostics
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-040-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: GMCP emits bounded OpenTelemetry-compatible traces, metrics and structured logs across host, gateway, transport, server and callback boundaries, propagating standard trace context from MCP metadata. RED/USE, queue, cache, policy, consent, task and lifecycle signals have stable schemas and cardinality budgets; payload redaction is structural; diagnostics explain failures locally and export only under explicit policy. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
